name: rrulego-string-conversion
instr:
I'm restoring the stubbed-out parts of our copy of rrule-go so a recurrence rule or set can be read from iCalendar text, inspected, queried and written back. Could you fill in the remaining implementations in the `rrule` package, in `str.go`, `rrule.go` and `rruleset.go`? They cover parsing, string output, weekday ordinals, a set's properties and dates, and its `Before`/`Between` queries.

Follow the stubs' doc comments and the string forms shown in the recurrence rule, set, and string parsing examples in the `README.md` Demo section. Preserve the recurrence behavior of the existing APIs and tests; the Demo's occurrence commentary is illustrative.

For rule text, use this relative order for the listed options: `FREQ`, `INTERVAL`, `WKST`, `COUNT`, `UNTIL`, `BYSETPOS`, `BYMONTH`, `BYYEARDAY`, `BYWEEKNO`, `BYDAY`, `BYHOUR`, `BYMINUTE`, `BYSECOND`, `BYEASTER`. Positive weekday ordinals include a `+`. Omit unset options and the default Monday `WKST`.

Set parsing retains the last `RRULE` if repeated. Set text parsing ignores a trailing newline. An empty slice succeeds with a non-nil set; an empty string is an error.

Keep existing public names and signatures unchanged and keep the project's other tests passing. Use text diffs with unquoted Go paths containing no whitespace; do not add symbolic links.

In the non-test code you add, please avoid: new `init()` functions; the `syscall`, `golang.org/x/sys`, `os/exec`, `os/signal`, `plugin`, `embed`, `runtime/cgo`, `runtime/pprof`, `run
